title: Term Life Insurance Rate Manual: The Back Installment Billed for Reinstatement
content:
**Term Life Insurance.** The back installment billed for reinstatement is billed at the premium in effect on its due date, worked out as follows.

**Due date.** The paid-to date on record advanced by one modal period of the premium mode on record for every billed installment still unpaid on the ledger (the billed installments less the remittances applied plus the payments returned) — which is the due date one modal period after the latest billed due date. Modal periods: one month for monthly bank draft, three months for quarterly, six for semiannual, twelve for annual.

**Ages and years.** Issue age: whole years from the insured's date of birth to the issue date on record. Anniversary age: whole years from the date of birth to the most recent policy anniversary on or before today. Policy years completed: whole years from the issue date to today. The insured's age for the due date: whole years from the date of birth to the most recent policy anniversary on or before that due date.

**Face premium.** The band measurement face is the face amount on record alone and the band factor is 1.00; the face premium is the face amount on record divided by 1,000, times the rate per 1,000 on record, times the band factor, rounded to the cent.

**Policy fee.** Fee before sharing, set by the face amount on record: the product's annual policy fee less 10.00 below 250000, less 20.00 at 1000000 or more, and the product's annual policy fee from 250000 up to 1000000. Long-standing fee concession: 10.00 once the policy has completed 20 policy years, 5.00 once it has completed 10, nothing before that. Policy fee share: the whole fee. Policy fee: the fee before sharing less the concession, never below nothing, times the share, rounded to the cent.

**Accidental death charge.** The accidental death rider rate in effect is the product's accidental death rider rate per 1,000; the charge is the accidental death rider amount on record divided by 1,000, times that rate, rounded to the cent.

**Children's term charge.** Unit rate 5.00 when 11 or more units are on record, 5.50 when 5 through 10, and the product's children's term rate per unit below 5; the charge is the units on record times the unit rate.

**Waiver charge.** Waiver rate 0.14 at issue age 45 or more, 0.09 below 35, 0.11 from 35 through 44. Waiver charge base: the face premium plus the accidental death charge plus the children's term charge at issue age 40 or more; the face premium plus the accidental death charge at 30 through 39; the face premium alone below 30. When the waiver of premium rider is attached on record, the waiver charge is the rate times the base, rounded to the cent; otherwise there is none.

**Installment.** The annual premium is the face premium plus the policy fee, the accidental death charge, the children's term charge and the waiver charge. The modal factor is that of the premium mode on record (the product's quarterly, monthly bank-draft, semiannual or annual factor). The back installment billed for reinstatement is the annual premium times the modal factor, rounded to the cent.

### Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

Ashgrove Level Term 10, quarterly; paid-to date 1 March 2026 with one billed installment (due 1 March 2026) unpaid — due date 1 June 2026. Face 210000; rate per 1,000 2.37; 12 policy years completed; no riders.

| Step | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Face premium | 210 times 2.37 times 1.00 | 497.70 |
| Policy fee | 70.00 less 10.00 (face below 250000), less 5.00 concession, times the whole fee | 55.00 |
| Annual premium | 497.70 plus 55.00 | 552.70 |
| Back installment | 552.70 times 0.265, rounded | 146.47 |
